app.name: EduBridge AI
app.tagline: Pakistan ke mustaqbil ke liye Mehfooz Agentic Learning Platform.

footer.copyright: © {year} EduBridge AI. PCTB aur STBB nisab ke liye.

notFound.title: Safha nahi mila
notFound.body: Ye safha mojood nahi hai, ya ise muntaqil kar diya gaya hai.

comingSoon.title: {feature} jald aa raha hai
comingSoon.body: EduBridge AI ka ye hissa abhi ban raha hai. Account bana lijiye, tayyar hote hi aap ke liye dastyab hoga.

role.title: EduBridge AI mein khush aamdeed
role.subtitle: Aage barhne ke liye apna kirdar muntakhab karein. Hum aap ke taleemi safar ke mutabiq tajurba tarteeb denge.
role.studentBody: Tasdeeq shuda nisab, bamaani AI tuition aur zati mutalie ke mansoobe tak rasai hasil karein.
role.teacherBody: Talaba ki paish raft dekhein, board se tasdeeq shuda mawad dein, aur har talib ilm ki madad karein.
role.parentBody: Digital tahaffuz yaqeeni banayein, tasdeeq shuda paish raft reports dekhein, aur taleemi kamyabiyon mein shareek hon.

common.passwordHint: Kam az kam aath huroof hone chahiye.
common.passwordTooShort: Kam az kam aath huroof istemal karein.

student.title: Talib ilm ka account banayein
student.subtitle: Nisab tak rasai ke liye apni tafseelat darj karein.
student.academicIntro: Apne nisab ki tarjeehat muntakhab karein.
student.groupHelp: Ikhtiyarat aap ki muntakhab class par munhasir hain.
student.reviewIntro: Account banane se pehle tasdeeq kar lein ke ye durust hain.
student.consentBody: Class 9 aur 10 ke talaba ke liye AI Tutor istemal karne se pehle sarparast ki tasdeeq lazmi hai.

teacher.title: Asatza ki registration
teacher.subtitle: Apne talaba ki nigrani aur madad ke liye platform mein shamil hon.

parent.title: Waldain ka account banayein
parent.subtitle: Agar aap ke bache ne dawat bheji hai to yahan account banayein, phir us dawat ka link khol kar tasdeeq karein.

errors.emailTaken: Is email par pehle se account mojood hai.
errors.invalidClassGroup: Ye group aap ki muntakhab class ke liye dastyab nahi.
errors.rateLimited: Bohat zyada koshishein. Barah-e-karam thori dair baad dobara koshish karein.
errors.generic: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.enumsTitle: Class aur mazameen ke ikhtiyarat load nahi ho sake
errors.enumsBody: Durust ikhtiyarat dikhane ke liye form ko in ki zaroorat hai.

hero.subtitle: Pakistani nisab par mabni aik aala karkardagi wala taleemi nizam, jo talaba ko unki apni zaban mein AI ki madad deta hai.

solutions.title: Har Talib Ilm ko Baikhtiyar Banana
solutions.subtitle: Jadeed classroom ki zarooriyat ke liye tayyar karda moassar zaraye.

students.title: 24/7 AI Tutor aur Hal
students.body: Science aur math aise tutor ke sath samjhein jo aap ki raftar ke mutabiq dhalta hai, aur apni pasandeeda zaban mein gehri wazahat hasil karein.
students.featureLanguages: English, Urdu aur Roman-Urdu ki sahulat
students.featureMethod: Sawal jawab ke zariye seekhne ka tareeqa
students.previewAnswer: Ye raha wo sawal, aik aik qadam kar ke hal kiya gaya.

teachers.title: Classroom ki Baseerat
teachers.body: Nisab ki kamiyon ko fori tor par pehchanein aur talaba ki paish raft tafseeli dashboards se dekhein.

parents.title: Be-misal Shaffafiyat
parents.body: Apne bache ke taleemi safar se mehfooz aur ghair mudakhilati paish raft reports ke zariye jure rahein.
parents.cardMasteryBody: Tamam boards mein karkardagi ki fori nigrani.
parents.cardPlannerBody: Imtihan ke liye AI se tayyar karda dohrai schedule.

capabilities.title: Bunyadi Salahiyatein
capabilities.subtitle: Ilmi imtiyaz aur takneeki hifazat ki bunyad par.
capabilities.curriculumBody: Board imtihan mein kamyabi ke liye PCTB aur STBB ke mutabiq.
capabilities.bilingualBody: English aur Urdu mein mukammal rawani, riyazi ki alamat samet.
capabilities.groundedBody: Mehfooz AI nizam jawabat ko tasdeeq shuda nisabi mawad par qaim rakhta hai.
capabilities.adaptiveBody: Fehm ki satah ke mutabiq dushwari ki khudkar tabdeeli.
